content.text: OverviewCampus Life Very Large • SuburbanAverage Per Year After Aid$24KUniversity Of Connecticut is a very large, 4-year, public university. This coed college is located in a suburban community in a suburban setting. It offers associate, bachelor's, certificate, master's, and doctoral degrees. This college has an acceptance rate of 54.51% and a graduation rate of 83%.From the InstitutionFounded in 1881, the University of Connecticut is ranked among the top public research universities in the United States. With 10 schools and colleges offering undergraduate degrees, students learn and work alongside dedicated faculty in their fields; bettering the world through research, advising, and mentorship.
